variables.name: kRepresentative
variables.meaning: representatives retained by the cached projection

assumptions: model generation, viewport, representative ceiling, canonical controller-owned view, view transform, and inset scalars are unchanged
caller-supplied scales, explicit view, and previous projection disable caching
consumers preserve borrowed projection buffers without mutation or detachment
contract.proof: The controller compares a fixed scalar cache key before constructing a resolved request and returns the single retained structurally immutable projection with borrowed binary storage in one Result wrapper.
contract.adversarialWitness: Repeated projection reads on a one-million-datum model return one object identity without domain traversal; a 50,000-read heap-allocation sample stays below one percent of an otherwise identical uncached previous-projection request.

fullScan.rationale: A cache hit cannot visit source data.

variables.name: cCommand
variables.meaning: commands emitted by one accepted transition

variables.name: q
variables.meaning: active and pending publication records in one synchronous drain

contract.proof: Each transition reserves one of 1,024 synchronous cascade slots before commit, captures one immutable snapshot/command record and current listener arrays, and drains records iteratively in FIFO order. Every captured target is attempted and the first user error is rethrown only after the queue is empty. Unsubscribe and controller disposal remove retained listeners idempotently.
contract.adversarialWitness: A command listener creates one nested state transition per delivered render command; revision 1,024 commits and the 1,025th transition returns a resource failure before commit.

fullScan.rationale: Publication iterates subscribed listeners only and never inspects chart data.

variables.name: nLayer
variables.meaning: declarative input layer count inspected before accessors
variables.ceiling: maxLayers or the first layer crossing maxDatums

contract.proof: Normalized limits are shared with model construction. The preflight reads only the layer array length and each data array length, accumulating the datum count before coordinate normalization, observations, accessors, or scale compilation.
contract.adversarialWitness: An over-ceiling definition with throwing identity and value accessors returns the layer or datum resource error with every accessor counter at zero; an accepted boundary visits each layer header once.

fullScan.rationale: Every accepted declarative layer contributes a data length to the global datum ceiling, so the bounded layer header array must be inspected once.

variables.name: nLayer
variables.meaning: raw model layer headers inspected before datum packing

variables.name: qOperation
variables.meaning: patch operation headers inspected before mutation work

assumptions: preflight reads layer and operation metadata plus data array lengths but not datum elements
patch layer indexes resolve through the retained immutable model index
contract.proof: Raw model normalization captures every bounded layer header before packing. Patch preflight copies current layer sizes once, resolves each bounded operation through the retained layer index, and updates a running total in declaration order before any datum is materialized or packed.
contract.adversarialWitness: An over-ceiling replacement or insert exposes datum arrays through read-counting proxies and returns the resource rejection with zero element reads; an insert-then-remove sequence that only fits at the end is rejected at its overflowing intermediate state.

fullScan.rationale: The final raw model count and every sequential patch intermediate count depend on all bounded headers, while datum storage must remain unobserved until the preflight succeeds.

operations.specificationCeiling: first lookup O(s), subsequent lookup expected O(1)

resources.cacheEntries: one weak owner entry per queried immutable point selection

contract.proof: The first membership query builds one StableID-preserving Set keyed weakly by the immutable selection owner; later DOM accessibility projections reuse expected-constant membership without rescanning the selection.
contract.adversarialWitness: A million selected numeric and string identities are queried repeatedly while only a bounded accessibility window is projected.

fullScan.rationale: The one-time index must contain every selected identity; subsequent membership queries cannot scan it.

contract.proof: Normalization validates and packs each datum once, builds one Core identity sequence, and retains profile indexes whose packed hierarchy and auxiliary entries are linear in their owning layer.
contract.adversarialWitness: A maximum-size mixed-profile model emits every packed value and retains fewer than four hierarchy leaves per datum plus profile-specific linear entries.

fullScan.rationale: External construction must validate every retained datum.

assumptions: the replace patch preserves layer cardinality
fixed 256-datum value blocks and hierarchy overlays rebuild at bounded depth 16
contract.proof: The owner copies only intersecting fixed-size blocks, patches the Core identity sequence, and records only affected leaf-to-root hierarchy paths; radial prefix repair counts its affected suffix as bIndex.
contract.adversarialWitness: One replacement in a 4,096-datum ordered layer copies one value block and repairs at most one leaf-to-root hierarchy path.

fullScan.rationale: A complete owner scan is permitted only at the bounded overlay-depth crossover; scannedDatums, bBlock, and bIndex then account for that rebuild explicitly.

contract.proof: The replacement validates and indexes one layer, patches the Core identity sequence once, creates at most nLayer lightweight views, and reuses every other immutable owner.
contract.adversarialWitness: Replacing one datum layer beside a one-million-datum unchanged layer reports one scanned datum and preserves the unchanged owner identity.

fullScan.rationale: A changed-layer replacement cannot inspect datum storage owned by unchanged layers.

variables.name: bBuffer
variables.meaning: bytes in distinct public typed-array backing buffers
variables.ceiling: projection binary storage bounded by maximumRepresentatives

variables.name: vView
variables.meaning: public typed-array views reachable from batches and data batches
variables.ceiling: a fixed number of views per emitted layer batch

resources.allocations: one ArrayBuffer per distinct source buffer and one typed-array view per distinct source view

assumptions: the input is a valid Chart-owned projection with attached borrowed buffers
contract.proof: The clone walks public batch and data-batch fields once. One map copies each distinct backing buffer exactly once, a second map recreates each distinct typed-array view exactly once, and both maps preserve source alias relationships inside the isolated result.
contract.adversarialWitness: A layered Cartesian plus radial projection shares identity, color, and polyline-offset views across public surfaces; the clone preserves those aliases, remains isolated from a second clone and the controller cache, and can transfer its buffer without detaching the source.

fullScan.rationale: An explicit consumer-owned binary clone must copy every reachable public backing-buffer byte once.

contract.proof: Model construction precomputes bounds; projection allocates layer quotas and visits only selected representative indexes.
contract.adversarialWitness: A maximum-size layered model emits the configured representative ceiling.

fullScan.rationale: When the representative ceiling is below source cardinality, projection must skip unrepresented source datums.

operations.specificationCeiling: O(nLayer + nAxis + nTick + log nDatum + qIndex + kRepresentative)

variables.name: nTick
variables.ceiling: sum of bounded axis tick maxima

variables.name: nDatum
variables.meaning: datums retained by the queried layer indexes

time.bound: O(nLayer + nAxis + nTick + log nDatum + qIndex + kRepresentative)

resources.cacheEntries: at most 8 per live geometry owner

assumptions: exact bar, pie, donut, raw scatter, and raw heatmap requests reject before partial publication when their quota is insufficient
Cartesian exact, line envelope, density, and heatmap requests consume retained visible-domain hierarchy nodes
aggregate representatives carry bounds, count, and reduction and never carry a datum identity
contract.proof: Axis layout visits bounded axes and ticks; exact Cartesian selection and aggregate reductions traverse retained visible-domain hierarchy nodes; line selection uses binary search plus retained range aggregates; output work follows emitted representatives. Compatible data-space geometry is retained by geometry token and bounded level key.
contract.adversarialWitness: One-million-datum line and density projections emit at most 8,192 representatives while diagnostics report hierarchy visits and zero full-source scans; exact profiles return a resource rejection instead of sampling.

fullScan.rationale: When semantic output is bounded below source cardinality, projection must use retained indexes or reject rather than scan the source.

operations.specificationCeiling: O(log kRepresentative + cCandidate + lLine log mLine + h log h)

variables.name: cCandidate
variables.meaning: BVH, equal-X, or equal-category candidates examined by the selected profile policy

variables.name: mLine
variables.meaning: maximum represented points in one ordered line batch

time.bound: O(log kRepresentative + cCandidate + lLine log mLine + h log h)

assumptions: prepareChartProjectionQueries or an earlier hit test built the projection BVH and categorical bar orders before any consumer-owned clone mutation
ordered-series projected X coordinates remain nondecreasing
contract.proof: Filled areas use exact BVH candidates; ordered lines use one binary search per bounded layer plus equal-X candidates; categorical bars use retained center orders; scatter points use the bounded-radius BVH. Deterministic diagnostics count visited nodes, tested primitives, and searched line or bar partitions.
contract.adversarialWitness: Dense overlapping geometry or repeated X/category coordinates visits every tied candidate; separated points, lines, and categories retain logarithmic lookup plus bounded leaves.

fullScan.rationale: Pointer queries use retained spatial, ordered-X, or categorical-center indexes instead of scanning unrelated projected primitives.

contract.proof: Primitive bounds are emitted once, Morton keys are sorted once, categorical bar records are sorted once by their dominant-axis centers, and one balanced packed hierarchy plus two packed bar orders is retained per structurally immutable projection owner.
contract.adversarialWitness: Every representative emits one sortable query primitive; every categorical bar additionally enters exactly one dominant-axis order.

fullScan.rationale: Index construction must include every queryable projected primitive.

resources.allocations: one axis record and one bounded axes array for an accepted transition; no state or axes snapshot allocation for a semantic no-op
resources.cacheEntries: one WeakMap entry per live view snapshot sharing the unchanged axis lookup

assumptions: view states originate from the validated Chart construction boundary
axis identities and order do not change during one input transition
logarithmic math runs in log space and categorical math runs in integral slot space
contract.proof: A retained StableID index resolves one axis, scalar scale-specific math produces one window, and accepted transitions replace one axis record in an array bounded by maxAxes. No-op transitions return the prior state identity.
contract.adversarialWitness: One million alternating zoom transitions across 16 mixed axes retain one lookup per transition and report bounded scalar math while snapshot publication never exceeds the hard 16-axis ceiling.

fullScan.rationale: One input transition must not scan chart data or search axes linearly.
